description.value:
Ability Scores: STR, CON, DEX

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.suns-of-rubi-core.feats.FeatToughOrigin1]{Tough}

Skill Proficiencies: Choose 2 from ATH, ITM, PLT, SUR

Feature: Clan Camaraderie

Among the Clan settlements, mining outposts, and rebel redoubts across the canyons of Rubi-Ka, you are recognized as a brother-in-arms. You can find free shelter, communal rations, and mechanical maintenance for your gear at any Clan settlement or nomad camp. Clan fighters, blacksmiths, and miners will share news of Omni-Tek patrol schedules, hazardous Notum sinkholes, and safe traversal routes through contested frontier zones.

Roleplay Characteristics

Personality Traits

d6 Trait
1I judge people by the calluses on their hands and whether they pull their own weight.
2I never complain about freezing frontier weather, dry rations, or exhaust fumes.
3A firm handshake and shared slug of harsh rotgut seal an agreement better than any datapad contract.
4I sing boisterous clan work anthems while hammering armor or servicing heavy machinery.
5I am fiercely loyal to anyone who stands shoulder-to-shoulder with me under enemy fire.
6I speak bluntly, without the deceptive polished manners of corporate suits.

Ideals

d6 Trait
1Solidarity. The clan survives only when every member protects the collective. (Lawful)
2Freedom. We were born free on this soil; no mega-corporation owns our lives or labor. (Chaotic)
3Strength. In a brutal frontier world, weakness is an invitation to subjugation. (Neutral)
4Brotherhood. An injury to one clansman is an injury to the entire family. (Good)
5Vengeance. Omni-Tek has made us bleed for generations; every debt will be repaid in blood. (Evil)
6Honor. Stand tall, keep your word, and die with your boots on. (Any)

Bonds

d6 Trait
1My heavy reinforced chestplate was forged from the salvaged plating of my father's mining mech.
2I would level an entire corporate forward base to free an imprisoned clansman.
3The elders of my clan entrusted me with our ancient muster roll and sacred banner.
4I fight to secure a fertile valley where the next generation of clansmen can live in peace.
5A comrade took a sniper round intended for me; their surviving children are my responsibility.
6My home settlement was bombed by corporate gunships; I will make them answer for it.

Flaws

d6 Trait
1I harbor an instant, boiling hatred for anyone wearing an Omni-Tek uniform or executive pin.
2I settle disputes with my fists before considering peaceful compromise.
3My stubborn pride makes it nearly impossible for me to admit when my plan has failed.
4I am distrustful of advanced ungrounded tech and highbrow corporate academia.
5I drink heavily to drown out the screams of lost skirmishes.
6I refuse to surrender or retreat, even when tactically overwhelmed.

advancement.title: Ability Score Improvement
advancement.hint: Your background allows you to increase your STR, CON, DEX scores: increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

advancement.title: Skill Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Choose 2 skills from: ath, itm, plt, sur.

advancement.title: Tool Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Your background grants you tool proficiency options.

advancement.title: Origin Feat
advancement.hint: Your background grants you the Tough origin feat.
